notes: These are Phase 1 rendering and rule tags, not kinetics-calibrated corrosion-rate models.
Anodize is explicitly a kinetics modifier, not an EMF shift.
Do not suppress active/passive dual-state display for stainless or titanium solely because passivation is selected.
Render as a rate modifier without moving the intrinsic EMF position.
Use the exposed plating material potential, not the substrate potential.
Partial coating damage does not qualify as circuit open.
